scenarios.prompt: Create a personal activity dashboard. Log a title, timestamp, numeric minutes, a Category choice, and multiline notes through reachable add/edit forms. Show a checklist of entries, a metric summing minutes with target 150, and a daily line chart summing minutes over the most recent 14 days. Include entry details. No reminders.

Create a personal photo journal with title, private photo, moment timestamp, caption, rating and favorite fields. Use a two-step add/edit form: first title, photo and moment timestamp; then multiline caption, rating and favorite. Include image cards, a gallery and linked entry details. No reminders.

scenarios.prompt: Build shared volunteer shift signups using the group capacity signup policy. Each shift has a title, required start timestamp and preparation notes. Expose shift list, capacity summary, reachable add/edit form, set-capacity, join and cancel-signup controls. Use one capacity pool per shift and an AppNest inbox reminder for active claimants one hour before the start.

Create a personal reading journal using personalTracker.v1. Use one Books collection with Title (required text), Author (optional text), Finished (required boolean) and Review (optional text). Include a searchable book list, linked details, reachable add/edit forms with multiline Review, and a checklist that toggles the Finished boolean. Use editorial appearance. No reminders.

Create a shared repair queue using groupWorkflow.v1. Use one Repairs collection with Title (required text), Stage (required choice: Queued, Resolved), Estimate (optional integer) and Notes (optional text). Include a draggable board grouped by Stage, with reversible transitions Queued to Resolved and Resolved to Queued, linked details and reachable add/edit forms with multiline Notes. No reminders.
